newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - June 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - June 24.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The height of the flame at the Magurchhara drilling site reduced further on Monday and came to a level of around ten feet.
Opposition leader Begum Khaleda Zia on Monday termed the one-year Awami League rule the "year of slavery and conspiracy".
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Monday said the greatest success of her one-year rule was to restore the spirit of the liberation war.
A team from the European Commission arrived in Bangladesh on Monday to inspect the condition of the plants processing frozen fishes for export to European markets.
Opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party has alleged that 10,000 of its leaders and workers are facing false cases.
Importers reconditioned cars on Monday demanded withdrawal of the proposed 25 percent luxuary tax on car imports.
Bhutan has shown interest in importing dry fish from Bangladesh.
The budget for 1997/98 fiscal year will dominate in Tuesday's consultation meeting between the government and international donors. REUTER
